prompt: Which of these is a famous place to visit in Indonesia?
explanation: Komodo National Park is one of the two places we'd love to visit in Indonesia. In Komodo National Park, rangers lead families to see real-life dragons — Komodo dragons, the world's largest lizards — plus pink-sand beaches and manta rays.
